alignments.note: Waw of the consecutive form rendered by the connective *Moreover* under rule 14's open list; the verb itself takes *came*.
הָיָה here is not presentative: the ASV writes an ordinary *came* for the word-event formula, so no rule 21 frame or rule 45 *that* is present to place.
Construct noun; the rectum is a proper name carrying no article morpheme, so the ASV's single *the* is a supplied one on the construct under rule 29.
Nomen rectum takes the relational *of* under rule 19, headed on the name.
Pronominal suffix takes the object pronoun under rule 18.
The לְ of לֵאמֹר has no English realization (rule 27).

review_notes: Standard prophetic word-event formula; the waw takes *Moreover* rather than *And* because that is the connective the ASV wrote (rule 14).
